strings.help: Add a separate entry for each medication. Include any relevant past medications, even if you are not currently taking any. Copy the information from the package or write “don’t know”; do not mention. Dietary supplements do not need to be listed here. Changes are only saved after “Save and continue.” If there are no details to add, skip the question.
strings.discussion: What would you like to ask your psychiatrist about medication? (optional)
strings.empty: Please enter at least one detail or skip the question.
strings.error: Check the drug information. Each field should contain text; keep it reasonably short.
strings.limit: You can add up to 50 medication records.
strings.unsaved: Drug information has not yet been saved.
strings.select: Enter only what you know. All fields are optional.
strings.historyTime: Current and significant previously used medicines. Record how they were actually taken; this is not treatment advice.
strings.bring: Below is the medication information you entered. If possible, bring the packaging, current medication list, and prescriptions with you so your doctor can verify the information.
strings.reportIntro: Information provided by the person themselves, not a diagnosis or treatment recommendation. Missing answers are not negative answers. Questions may refer to different time periods.
strings.medNote: Self-reported medication information only. Do not mention units of measurement, calculate doses, suggest changes, or infer causality based on timing alone. Missing fields remain unknown. Current and past use, total duration, and duration at a specific dose are different pieces of information.

fields.name: Exact name of the medicine
fields.dose: Actual amount used at one time
fields.schedule: How often and when do you use it (also as needed)
fields.duration: How long have you been taking it/approximate start date
fields.doseDuration: How long have you been taking this dose?
fields.reason: What do you use it for?
fields.effects: What improved, worsened, or caused side effects?
fields.changes: Symptoms or changes after starting, changing, skipping, or stopping medication; timing, if known
fields.stoppedWhen: When and how you stopped (immediately/gradually), if applicable
fields.stopReason: Why did you stop, if applicable?

status.past: I used it before / stopped using it
status.unknown: I don't know / I'm not sure
